facility.name: Kids Are Angels Learning Center
facility.programs_provided: School Age Care,Before School Care,Meals Provided ,After School Care,Snacks Provided,Drop-In Care,Part Time Care,Transportation to/from School ,Field Trips

provenance.note: Census Geocoder Non_Exact match: 342 WHITEWOOD DR, SAN ANTONIO, TX, 78242

inspection_summary.note: Texas HHSC inspections, report investigations and assessments since October 2017, updated daily.

occurrences.finding: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity: The operation left a 3yr old child on the playground for two minutes.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Demonstrate Competency, Good Judgment, Self-control: During the course of a DFPS investigation, it was determined the operation staff failed to demonstrate good judgement when caregivers on the playground failed to ensure that children?s shoes were kept on, or put back on after being removed, while being outdoors resulting in one child burning the bottom of their feet and sustaining second degree burns.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Demonstrate Competency, Good Judgment, Self-control (26 TAC §746.1201(1))

occurrences.finding: Measurement of Use Zone for Slides - in Front of Access and on Sides: During a DFPS investigation, it was determined the play equipment on the infant playground did not have the required 6 feet diameter between equipment and fall zones.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Measurement of Use Zone for Slides - in Front of Access and on Sides (26 TAC §746.4805(a))

occurrences.finding: Written Operational Policies - Parent Rights: 7 out of the 10 children's files reviewed did not have signed parent rights form on file.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Operational Policies - Parent Rights (26 TAC §746.501(a)(20))

occurrences.finding: Prohibited Punishments - Grabbing and Pulling: Based on the evidence gathered, a caregiver used prohibited punishment when they grabbed and pulled a child by the arms to get the child to go back inside because the child refused to leave the playground.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Prohibited Punishments - Grabbing and Pulling (26 TAC §746.2805(3))

occurrences.finding: Required Admission Information - Special Needs Statement: Based on the evidence gathered, a child with known special care needs and medication requirements did not have a special care needs statement in their admissions file to inform staff how they can best support the child.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Admission Information - Special Needs Statement (26 TAC §746.605(12))

occurrences.finding: Prohibited Punishments - Grabbing and Pulling: Based on the evidence gathered, a caregiver used prohibited punishment when they grabbed and pulled a child by the arms to take the child into the front office because the child did not follow directions.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Prohibited Punishments - Grabbing and Pulling (26 TAC §746.2805(3))

occurrences.finding: Mark Cleaning Supplies, Toxic Materials; Keep Separate from Food and Inaccessible to Children: Several gallon jugs of bleach were observed in the children's restroom and accessible to children. This was corrected when it was addressed with the person in charge and the bottles were removed from the restroom.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Mark Cleaning Supplies, Toxic Materials; Keep Separate from Food and Inaccessible to Children (26 TAC §746.3407(12))

occurrences.finding: Written Feeding Instructions - Signed and Dated by Parent or Health-Care Professional: Based on the evidence gathered, infant caregivers did not follow written feeding instructions from the parent of an 8-month-old, between the following dates: 9/18/24 through 9/30/24.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Feeding Instructions - Signed and Dated by Parent or Health-Care Professional (26 TAC §746.2421(a))

occurrences.finding: Child/ Caregiver Ratio - 13 or More Children: One caregiver was observed alone in a classroom with 6 infants with a specified age group of 0-11 months. This was corrected when a second caregiver returned to the infant classroom.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Child/ Caregiver Ratio - 13 or More Children (26 TAC §746.1601)

occurrences.finding: Prohibited Punishments - Corporal Punishment: Based on the evidence found, a caregiver used forms of inappropriate discipline. The caregiver "tapped" a toddler on the hand to physically redirect them from hitting another child. The caregiver also "tapped" their hand on another toddler's mouth when physically redirecting the child from biting.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Prohibited Punishments - Corporal Punishment (26 TAC §746.2805(1))

occurrences.finding: Maintenance Procedures for Active Play - Inspect Daily: A check of the outdoor play space prior to use was not properly conducted as there was debris observed on the playground where toddlers were playing.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Maintenance Procedures for Active Play - Inspect Daily (26 TAC §746.4751(a))

occurrences.finding: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - Pediatric CPR: A caregiver who has been employed over 90 days does not have current CPR training.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - Pediatric CPR (26 TAC §746.1301(a)(4)(A))

occurrences.finding: Prohibited Punishments - Corporal Punishment: During inspection, a caregiver was heard telling her biological child who is also enrolled in care that she would spank him if he didn't behave.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Prohibited Punishments - Corporal Punishment (26 TAC §746.2805(1))

occurrences.finding: Mark Cleaning Supplies, Toxic Materials; Keep Separate from Food and Inaccessible to Children: Cleaning solutions were observed stored under a sink in the young toddlers room without a child safety lock. This was corrected when the caregiver removed all cleaning solutions and other toxic chemicals from under the sink.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Mark Cleaning Supplies, Toxic Materials; Keep Separate from Food and Inaccessible to Children (26 TAC §746.3407(12))

occurrences.finding: Posting Requirements - Child's Food Allergy Plans: No information was observed posted in the classrooms or kitchen for one child with a diagnosed food allergy requiring a food allergy emergency plan. This was corrected when staff printed and posted  the child's name and allergy information in classrooms and kitchen.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Posting Requirements - Child's Food Allergy Plans (26 TAC §746.403(b))

occurrences.finding: Transportation Safety Training -Director and Employee Complete 2 Hours Annually: A caregiver was observed transporting school age children for a field trip without current training in transportation safety. This was corrected when the caregiver completed transportation safety training prior to transporting the children back to the operation.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Transportation Safety Training -Director and Employee Complete 2 Hours Annually (26 TAC §746.1316(a))

occurrences.finding: Infant Care Area Furnishings and Equipment -Use of Safety Straps: Based on evidence gathered, a caregiver did not use the safety straps on a highchair to secure an infant in the highchair which resulted in the infant falling from the highchair and injuring their head on the floor.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Infant Care Area Furnishings and Equipment -Use of Safety Straps (26 TAC §746.2407)

occurrences.finding: Director Responsibilities - Operate in Compliance: Based on the evidence gathered, the director confirmed she was aware of the minimum standard requirement to notify Child Care Regulation of a child injury that requires medical treatment however the director stated she did not report the infant's injury.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Director Responsibilities - Operate in Compliance (26 TAC §746.1003(1))

occurrences.finding: AP Report Child Injury Requiring Medical Treatment by a Health-Care Professional or Hospitalization: Based on evidence gathered, the operation did not report a child injury requiring medical treatment to Child Care Regulation within the required timeframe.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Report Child Injury Requiring Medical Treatment by a Health-Care Professional or Hospitalization (26 TAC §746.305(a)(2))

occurrences.finding: Handwashing Procedures: A caregiver was observed using a spray bottle of water and soap to wash a three years old's hands inside the classroom.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Handwashing Procedures (26 TAC §746.3419)

occurrences.finding: Food Allergy Emergency Plan Signed by Parents and Health Care Professional: A child with a diagnosed allergy and prescribed epi-pen did not have a signed allergy emergency plan on file.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Food Allergy Emergency Plan Signed by Parents and Health Care Professional (26 TAC §746.3819)

occurrences.finding: Mark Cleaning Supplies, Toxic Materials; Keep Separate from Food and Inaccessible to Children: Spray bottles containing cleaning liquids were observed accessible to the children in the two year old classroom.    Note: This was corrected at inspection as the spray bottles were removed to a higher location.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Mark Cleaning Supplies, Toxic Materials; Keep Separate from Food and Inaccessible to Children (26 TAC §746.3407(12))

occurrences.finding: Annual Fire Inspection - Before Initial Permit Issued and Every 12 Months: The operation did not receive a fire inspection within the last 12 months.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Annual Fire Inspection - Before Initial Permit Issued and Every 12 Months (26 TAC §746.5101(a))

occurrences.finding: Electronic Child Safety Alarm - installed and maintained according to manufacturer's instructions: The electronic safety alarm installed in the two vehicles used to transport the children in care is still not functioning.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Electronic Child Safety Alarm - installed and maintained according to manufacturer's instructions (26 TAC §746.5625(b))

occurrences.finding: Safety - Areas Free From Hazards: A shed located in the playground containing hazards still did not have a lock.     Children's over the counter medication was observed not accessible to the children in care.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety - Areas Free From Hazards (26 TAC §746.3701)

occurrences.finding: Electronic Child Safety Alarm - installed and maintained according to manufacturer's instructions: The electronic safety alarm installed in the two vehicles used to transport the children in care were observed not functioning.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Electronic Child Safety Alarm - installed and maintained according to manufacturer's instructions (26 TAC §746.5625(b))

occurrences.finding: Positive Methods of Discipline and Guidance - Use Praise and Encouragement: A caregiver was observed not using positive interaction with a three year old in care by sitting the child down forcefully and using harsh tones when instructing the child on what to do.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Positive Methods of Discipline and Guidance - Use Praise and Encouragement (26 TAC §746.2803(4)(A))

occurrences.finding: Emergency Evacuation and Relocation Diagram - Posted in Each Room: The emergency evacuation and relocation diagram were not observed posted in three classrooms during inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Emergency Evacuation and Relocation Diagram - Posted in Each Room (26 TAC §746.5207(b))

occurrences.finding: Mark Cleaning Supplies, Toxic Materials; Keep Separate from Food and Inaccessible to Children: Spray bottles containing cleaning solutions were observed accessible to the children in care.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Mark Cleaning Supplies, Toxic Materials; Keep Separate from Food and Inaccessible to Children (26 TAC §746.3407(12))

occurrences.finding: Documented Annual Training - Caregivers of Children Under 24 Months Required: Two out of the three staff records reviewed during inspection did not contain SIDS, Baby Shaken Syndrome and Brain development trainings.    One out of three staff files reviewed during inspection did not contain Administering medication.     Note: SIDS training was corrected at inspection as it was completed during inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Documented Annual Training - Caregivers of Children Under 24 Months Required (26 TAC §746.1309(d))

occurrences.finding: Safety - Areas Free From Hazards: A shed located in the playground containing hazards did not have a lock.     Children's over the counter medication was observed accessible to the children in care.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety - Areas Free From Hazards (26 TAC §746.3701)
